Q11. Which of the following is a merit of migrating an internal business system to a cloud
service?

options.text:
If an internal business system that requires a very high level of availability is to be
migrated to IaaS, all service providers guarantee high availability, so the migration is
easy.

If an internal on-premises business system with company-specific functions is to be
migrated to a system provided by SaaS, the migration of the company-specific functions
also becomes easier.

If PaaS is to be used, platform management and OS updates are performed by the service
provider, so the burden of installation and operation can be reduced.

If SaaS is to be used temporarily for the development or evaluation of an internal
business system, a highly flexible development environment can be provided.

questions.promptText: Q22. Which of the following is an appropriate explanation of the granularity of locks?

options.text:
When large granularity is set for a large number of transactions to update the same data,
the number of transactions that can be executed simultaneously increases.

When large granularity is set for all data in a table to be referenced, data referenced from
other transactions can remain undisturbed.

When large granularity is set for data to be updated, the waiting times for other
transactions increase, and the total throughput declines.

When large granularity is set, the number of data items included increases, and the
number of locks that one transaction makes increases.

questions.promptText: Q27. Which of the following is the attack that is classified as DNS cache poisoning?

options.text:

it leads the user to a fake server.

steppingstone to send a large number of recursive queries.

In order to obtain internal information, the zone information stored in the DNS server is
compiled and transferred.

The version information of the DNS server software is obtained to identify a security
hole.

questions.promptText: Q29. Which of the following is a merit in using SaaS?

options.text:
No system access management needs to be performed, and no consideration concerning
the procedure for password initialization or a password policy that satisfies complexity
requirements is required.

No system construction needs to be performed, and neither the definition of security
requirements for application software development nor the design of storage volume for
system logs is required.

No system operation needs to be performed, and no consideration concerning work
procedures at the time of a failure or backup is required.

No system security management needs to be performed, and neither the creation of
information security management rules nor the assignment of an administrator is
required.

questions.promptText: Q49. Which of the following is an explanation of green procurement?

options.text:
It refers not only to the fulfillment of the requirements of quality and price but to the
preferential purchase of products and services with a lower environmental burden from
companies that work toward a reduction in their environmental impact.

It refers to a certificate that enables commercial trading of the green power that is
generated from natural energy sources such as solar, biomass, wind power, and
geothermal heat.

It refers to international standards concerning environmental labels that are certified by a
third party on the basis of certain criteria.

It refers to mass promotion of the details of environmental protection activities and
raising funds for environmental protection from investors.

questions.promptText: Q50. Which of the following is a characteristic of the growth stage in a product life cycle?

options.text:
Demand decreases, and the withdrawal of some companies is observed. A decision
needs to be made regarding whether it is possible to gain a strong foothold at this stage.
Migration into an alternative market is also considered.

Demand is occasional, and exploiting new demand is key to success. Conviction for
succeeding in a specific target market is necessary.

Demand reaches a peak, and the differentiation of the product and segmentation of the
market become clear. The competition between competitors also intensifies, and it
becomes important to add new product types and reduce costs.

The market starts to understand the value of the product. Both the product line and
distribution channels need to be expanded. This stage sees an increase in sales and also
requires investment.

questions.promptText: Q51. Which of the following is a description of cost-plus pricing?

options.text:
It determines a competitive price by referring to the industry average and the pricing of
competitors.

It determines a price by adding a certain margin to the manufacturing cost and the
purchasing cost.

It determines a price that ensures a certain profit margin after all costs are covered on the
basis of a target volume of sales.

It determines an appealing price by researching the quality and price that customers
accept.

questions.promptText: Q52. Which of the following is an explanation of Supply Chain Management (SCM)?

options.text:
Customer information that are collected through various channels is consolidated and
utilized to establish closer relationships with customers.

Employees’ skills and behavior characteristics are grasped, and management such as
appropriate personnel assignment and evaluation from the perspective of human
resources strategy is performed.

Intellectual assets of individuals, such as know-how and experience, are shared across
the organization to be used for creative work.

The entire series of business operations, from purchasing and production to sales and
distribution, is reexamined both within the company and among companies in view of
total optimization in order to shorten delivery times and minimize inventory.
